metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Jonah Schulte

plugins.name: editor-rescue
plugins.description: Rescue hundreds of hoarded unsaved Sublime Text / VS Code / Cursor buffers into organized notes, flag pasted credentials, and reset the editors so they open empty again.

plugins.name: codebase-audit
plugins.description: 11 skills for auditing a codebase: health-audit (scored, with separate grades for build quality and live harm), health-sweep (runs every applicable lens in parallel and merges the results), seven lenses (health-audit-ux, -api, -data, -domain, -dx, -ops, -seo), arch-audit (every violation of the codebase's own conventions) and finish-line (a roadmap for what done should mean).

plugins.name: pr-workflow
plugins.description: 5 skills for the life of a pull request: deliver-me (one change end to end, unsupervised), productionize (draft PR to reviewable PR), pr-resolver (resolve review feedback), bulletproof (a release verdict before merging) and issue-burndown (a backlog of issues into batched PRs).

plugins.name: whats-left
plugins.description: Ask where a long session stands and get an honest ledger: what is verifiably done, every step still between here and finished, and an offer to carry all of it out.
